title: A fresh HTTP cache hit
subtitle: A small authoring example: follow an eligible stored response back to its caller.
question: When can a cache answer without contacting the origin?
scope: Illustrative GET with a matching, reusable stored response and a clock. Cache directives, authentication and Vary conditions already permit reuse. This is a protocol example, not an implementation trace.

project.name: HTTP Caching
project.license: IETF Trust; this model paraphrases the specification.

claims.text: Reuse requires matching and permission conditions as well as freshness. A cache returning a stored response without validation generates an Age header.
Freshness compares freshness lifetime with current age. An eligible fresh response can be reused without origin validation.

takeaways.text: An eligible fresh hit returns the stored response without origin validation.

limits: This small example excludes validation, misses, eviction and directive interactions. It contains no runtime observations.
